messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: 14 nodes in eu-west1-rack-7 toggled secureboot during fw roll; 9 failed to boot, 5 entered SMM thermal throttle and NVMe errors, GPU allocs failing -> provisioning backlog +130.

lina: seeing it, grabbing logs from jump host. any deployed fw version id?
raj: firmware v2.3.7-rc4 pushed in last canary window at 09:02 UTC. rollback job scheduled at 11:00 by deploy bot but paused.
charlie: confirmed ipmi sessions to rack-7 are flaky. ipmitool responses timing out, KVM jump host dropping packets. small sample attached:
charlie: ```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-7 -U admin -P **** sol info
Error: Connection timed out
# journalctl -u fw-update | tail -n 20
Oct 03 09:03 fw-update[...]: signed image applied, triggering secure-boot-toggle
Oct 03 09:03 kernel: NMI: SMM thermal event on CPU0
Oct 03 09:04 nvme0: SMART error: controller reset
```
lina: sounds like the fw toggles UEFI secure boot flag on some HW variants -> OS kernel panics on our NVMe driver path. That explains the SMM thermal spikes.
kai: impact on scheduler: node readiness probe failing, pods getting evicted; we've got a queue in provisioning; estimate 120 GPUs stuck. Cost spike as jobs retry.
raj: immediate mitigation: add rack-7 to isolation set in fleet-router to route new allocs elsewhere; disable autoscale for affected pools to avoid retries.
charlie: can we flip BMC setting to keep secureboot state unchanged? ipmitool not responding for many hosts.
lina: plan B: trigger fw rollback via oob-provisioner queued job that uses serial console (fallback path) to restore bios image v2.3.6. I'll start canary on 2 nodes.
kai: I'll update autoscaler and scheduler taints. also opening a ticket for billing about retry costs.
ops-bot: rollback job queued: RBK-1754, canary nodes: /rack-7/node-03, /rack-7/node-06. ETA ~18m.
raj: heads-up: jump-hosts in eu-west1 are on same rack; alternatives: use eu-west1-b jump host in different rack to reach BMCs.
charlie: serial consoles ok for node-03 but node-06 serial is dropping; scheduling manual console attach.
lina: if serial fails, next option is instruct on-site tech to use local BMC console. paging fieldops@vendor.
kai: after rollback, we should update release pipeline to not flip secureboot bit by default and add HW-variant check. file a PR for fw packager.
lina: also let's add a metric alert for 'fw_toggles.secureboot' to catch this earlier.
charlie: rolling rollback now on canary. will post status.
(10m later)
charlie: canary node-03 is back to Ready, NVMe errors cleared. node-06 still in SMM thermal hold, manual console connected, reflash in progress.
lina: great. roll forward plan: pause remainder of rollout, run targeted rollback for rack-7, then validate on 3 more racks before resuming.
kai: I've tainted nodes and updated autoscale. eviction cost estimate so far ~$2.4k in retried GPU minutes. billing ticket TPM-203 opened.
raj: once rollback complete, schedule a postmortem: root cause: fw image toggles secureboot flag for HW-variants A/B mismatch. remediation: fw unifies behavior, release gate for variant check, improved oob fallback.
lina: assigning follow-ups: charlie->execute rollback, kai->scheduler/isolation, raj->release pipeline change, lina->alerts+postmortem doc. ack?
charlie: ack.
kai: ack.
raj: ack.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated for rack-7 canary; monitoring for regression for next 4 hours. :thumbsup:
